attackers_goals: Intercept the requests to the Kubernetes API sever, records secrets, and other sensitive information. Modify requests to the Kubernetes API sever.
description: A Kubernetes admission controller has been created or modified.
investigative_actions: Verify whether the identity should use Kubernetes admission controllers. Examine the role of the Kubernetes admission controller and its intended function. Investigate other operations that were performed by the identity within the cluster.
